text:
Priya Desai: Heads-up — Citrine Labs asks for a special one-time handshake rate for a 12mo Dedicated commit. They want a 20% effective discount for first 3 months plus a retro credit for onboarding overages.
Samir Patel: Can you share the commit size and ARR impact?
Priya Desai: They committed to 75k/mo reserved (GPU pool) starting May 1. ARR impact ~ $900k. The ask: 20% discount on first 3 invoices and a retro credit for their April pilot overage of ~$18k.
Janelle (RevOps): 20% on reserved for 3 months is outside standard tier. Need Deal Desk approval + legal on payment terms. Also they requested Net60 instead of our standard Net30 for reserved contracts.
Alex Morgan: Why Net60? Is there a procurement constraint? Any SOC/compliance blockers?
Priya Desai: Procurement is on their side — CFO asks for Net60 to align with their payment cycles. No compliance issues, they've signed the DPA. They're asking to remove the usage cap for first 60 days while ramping.
Samir Patel: Removing usage cap + Net60 + discounted reserved price is a lot of credit exposure. We should add a usage-based clawback or escrow for the first quarter. Proposal: approve 20% for 3 months conditional on a capped retro credit of $20k and auto-reversion to standard rates after month 3.
Janelle (RevOps): Agree with conditional approval. Requesting a formal note: 
```
Deal: Citrine Labs
Commit: 75k/mo reserved (12mo)
Requested concession: 20% off first 3 months + retro credit <= $20k
Payment terms: Net60 (one-time exception)
Operational: remove usage cap for first 60 days
Condition: escrow or clawback for any usage beyond 200% of baseline
```
Priya Desai: tagging Legal for Net60 and T&Cs: @LegalBot 
RevenueOps Bot: Deal submitted for Approval Queue as DD-4872. Current status: Pending finance review.
LegalBot: Quick read — Net60 ok for this customer with CFO sign-off; include an invoice schedule and a one-time fee to offset DSO risk (suggest $10k). Need final sign-off from CFO and RevOps.
Samir Patel: Recommend finance approve the 3-month 20% with the $20k retro cap + $10k DSO fee, and require invoice schedule + escrow. I can sign off if RevOps & Legal confirm wording.
Janelle (RevOps): I can approve subject to legal adding the invoice schedule clause and sales getting CFO acknowledgement in writing. Please record the decision in the Deal Desk sheet. :white_check_mark:
Priya Desai: Great — I'll get the acknowledgement and update the contract draft. Thanks team. :bow:
